categories.main_business_segments: San Fang Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the R&D, production, and sales of PU synthetic leather, eco-friendly synthetic leather, thin films, and other related materials. The company serves industries including footwear, garments, automotive interiors, and furniture, focusing on functional and sustainable materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polyurethane leather coating and finishing processes, including multi-layer liquid coating, drying, aging, printing, and treatment. It emphasizes eco-friendly and carbon reduction process technologies, recyclable materials, no-sew technology for shoemaking, and functional films and fibers. Automation, digitalization, and lean production methods are also key to their manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: San Fang serves major international brands in the sports shoes, casual footwear, garment, and automotive sectors. Its customers include top global brands requiring innovative, functional, and sustainable materials. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships and focuses on meeting diverse design and performance needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases and sales offices in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Indonesia, and other Asian regions. It exports primarily to Asia (88%) and other regions (10%), with a strong presence in Greater China and Southeast Asia. Overseas production capacity is expanded to meet localized manufacturing demands and mitigate supply chain risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: San Fang operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical and synthetic leather industry chain. It produces key synthetic leather materials and functional films, supplying to footwear and garment manufacturers, thus positioned as a materials supplier close to end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovative R&D in eco-friendly, recyclable, and functional materials, including sustainable artificial leather and advanced films. It invests 3-4% of annual revenue in R&D, focusing on product differentiation, environmental sustainability, and expanding applications beyond footwear. Overseas production expansion, lean manufacturing, and digitalization are strategic operational focuses.
categories.revenue_model: San Fang generates revenue primarily through product sales of synthetic leather, eco-friendly materials, and functional films. It maintains diversified product lines to meet various market demands and leverages long-term contracts with major brands. The company also benefits from investment income and manages costs through vertical integration and supply chain optimization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from South Korean and Chinese synthetic leather manufacturers, especially those leveraging low-cost production. However, San Fang positions itself as a leading supplier through technological innovation, quality control, diversified product offerings, and strong partnerships with international brands. Its early overseas capacity deployment and sustainability focus provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: San Fang reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$10.78 billion in 2024, a 7% increase from 2023, with net profit after tax nearly doubling to NT$1.48 billion. Total assets grew by 11.11% to NT$17.37 billion. The company shows steady growth supported by increased sales, improved productivity, and investment gains, with ongoing capital expenditures for capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: San Fang emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and environmentally sustainable synthetic leather and functional materials. Its value proposition includes advanced eco-friendly technologies, product customization to meet brand-specific needs, rapid localized production, and comprehensive quality control. The company’s commitment to sustainability, including recyclable materials and carbon reduction, differentiates it in the market.
